verdict.rationale: Notte's own Functions feature lets you deploy browser automations as serverless endpoints that can be invoked and scheduled, so time-based triggers run actions automatically. Nothing documents event-driven rules: no event sources, conditions or rule definitions, and no webhook or event listeners that fire actions. Missing for 10: event-based trigger rules, condition/rule configuration, documented event sources (webhooks, page changes, inbound email), independent corroboration.
